name: MemoryOS
summary: Hierarchical short/mid/long-term memory system for personalized agents, as a PyPI package and an MCP server.
description: MemoryOS (EMNLP 2025 Oral) applies operating-system memory-management ideas to agents: hierarchical short-term, mid-term and long-term personal memory with dynamic updating, retrieval and generation. Available as a Python package (`memoryos-pro` on PyPI) and as **MemoryOS-MCP**, which exposes memory tools to MCP clients. Supports multiple LLM providers and embeddings such as BGE-M3 and Qwen3.

agent_access.notes: pip install memoryos-pro, or run the MemoryOS-MCP server from the repo; needs your own LLM API key.

maintainer: BAI-LAB (Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications)
